description_for_human: Cloud storage with an email address for every bucket.
description_for_model: Cloud storage with an email address for every bucket. Store and share files with authorized people and AI agents; receive email and attachments. Read original messages, decoded bodies, and attachments with bucket file tools. Signup is browser-only. Connect through OAuth for hosted MCP or CLI browser sign-in; never ask users to paste credentials in chat. Storage and collaboration follow the Terms of Use. The OpenAPI document covers selected REST endpoints; see api.md for the complete API.
